FULL REWRITE. You own navbar, footer, mobile-nav, globals.css, and layout.tsx. Your job is to make these IDENTICAL to the Webflow source. Read the Webflow HTML and CSS, then WRITE the files. No planning.

Project: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/`

## STEP 1: Read Webflow source
- Read `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html` lines 1-500 (header/nav) and last 500 lines (footer)
- Grep CSS file for EVERY class used: `nav-23-*`, `header-sec`, `banner-*`, `footer*`, `nav-dropdown-*`, `logo`, `a-gulf-book`, `a-except-get`, `button-secondary-small`, `footer-newsletter-card`, `footer-links-grid`, `footer-link`, `footer-title`, `footer-social-link`, `legal-wrapper`
- Read ALL responsive breakpoints for these classes (991px, 767px, 479px)

## STEP 2: Read current files
- `src/app/globals.css`
- `src/app/layout.tsx`
- `src/components/layout/navbar.tsx`
- `src/components/layout/mobile-nav.tsx`
- `src/components/layout/footer.tsx`
- `src/lib/constants/navigation.ts`
- `src/components/ui/sheet.tsx`

## STEP 3: REWRITE every file

### globals.css requirements:
- @font-face for RoobertPRO (300, 400, 500, 700) — already using localFont, so just CSS vars
- :root variables matching Webflow exactly: --blue: #082753, --white: white, --black: black, --para-small: 16px, --h2: 40px, --h1: 3.125rem, --para: 1.125rem, --h3: 1.53rem, --button-text: 1rem
- Body: font-size 16px, line-height 28px, font-weight 400, color #111827, font-family Roobert PRO
- h2 default: font-size 40px, font-weight 700, line-height 45px
- .paragraph: font-size 16px, line-height 28px, color #2b2b2b, text-align center
- button, [role=button]: cursor pointer
- img: max-width 100%, vertical-align middle, display inline-block
- Gradient utility: .gradient-cyan = linear-gradient(90deg, #21cfff, #019ae6)
- Smooth scroll + prefers-reduced-motion

### navbar.tsx requirements (from Webflow CSS):
- `.banner-section`: bg #082753, padding 10px 5%, text-align center
- `.navbar`: bg #fff, padding 6px 1%, position sticky top-0, z-index 999999
- `.nav-23-container`: gap 10px, justify-content space-between, width 100%, display flex
- `.nav-23-left`: gap 40px, flex 0 auto, align-items center
- `.nav-23-logo`: width 130px, height 100%
- `.nav-23-link`: color #000, bg transparent, border-radius 8px, padding 8px 5px, transition bg-color .3s color .3s
- `.nav-23-link:hover`: bg #21cfff12, color #082753
- `.nav-23-dropdown-toggle`: same as nav-23-link + gap 6px
- `.nav-23-dropdown-arrow`: width 14px, height 14px, transition transform .5s
- Solutions dropdown card: `.nav-dropdown-card-3` min-width 410px, bg white, border-radius 12px, shadow 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.08), padding 12px
- Resources dropdown: `.nav-23-dropdown-card` border 1px solid #dde3e8, border-radius 12px, min-width 190px, padding 8px
- `.login-cta`: border 1px solid #082753, color #082753, border-radius 10px, padding 8px 20px, font-size 13px, font-weight 700
- `.login-cta:hover`: bg #082753, color white
- `.a-gulf-book` (Schedule Demo): bg-image Group-46729-2.svg + gradient, bg-position 93%, border-radius .75rem, padding .75rem 3rem .75rem 1.25rem, font-size 1rem, font-weight 700
- Hamburger: `.nav-23-menu-button` bg black, width 48px, height 48px, border-radius 10px

### footer.tsx requirements (from Webflow CSS):
- `.footer`: bg #082753, padding 72px 5% 16px, max-width container 1280px
- Grid: .75fr 1.25fr (left newsletter, right links)
- `.footer-newsletter-card`: radial-gradient bg, border .5px solid #05bafe61, border-radius 20px, padding 30px, box-shadow inset 0 0 100px #092955
- Newsletter form: input full width, button absolute right 1.5%, gradient bg, border-radius 10px, padding 12px 20px
- `.footer-right`: logo f-new.svg, 3 social icons (38x38, bg rgba(255,255,255,.05), border-radius 10px)
- Links grid: .75fr 1.25fr 1fr 1fr, gap 24px col / 56px row
- `.footer-title`: font-size 18px, font-weight 700, color white
- `.footer-link`: font-size 16px, color rgba(255,255,255,.8), hover color white
- `.legal-wrapper`: bg #113569, border-radius 10px, padding 4px 15px
- Responsive at 991px: grid-cols-1, links grid 4 cols. At 767px: links grid 2 cols. At 479px: form button stacks below input

### mobile-nav.tsx requirements:
- At 767px: bg #082753, flex-flow column, padding 10px 4%
- Links: white text, border-bottom 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04), padding 12px 0
- Dropdown arrow: color #21cfff
- Coming soon badge: bg #e6f7ff, color #1890ff

## RULES
- Use inline `style={{}}` for complex values Tailwind can't express (gradients with multiple backgrounds, radial gradients, inset shadows)
- Use Tailwind for standard values (padding, margin, flex, grid, colors, border-radius)
- `"use client"` only for components with state (hamburger toggle, newsletter form)
- NO `any` types
- Every image path: `/images/webflow/FILENAME`
- ALL responsive breakpoints must be implemented using Tailwind `max-[991px]:`, `max-[767px]:`, `max-[479px]:`
- Copy text WORD FOR WORD from the HTML
- Copy SVG icons inline from the HTML (social icons, arrow icons, chevron)

WRITE ALL FILES NOW. Start with globals.css, then navbar.tsx, mobile-nav.tsx, footer.tsx.
